title: Bog oak
description: This mod add bog oak to minecraft!
body:
This is a mod for a new rare wood that only spawn in rivers - the bog oak!

**generation**: bog oak spawn under grass and dirt in river biomes![Underwater bog oak](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfc00b0b6e79a313c5ef75f453dd689151863eb8.png)

**fuel** bog oak planks can smelt 10 items, bog oak log - 20 and bog oak wood - 30

**The bog oak button** should be pressed for 5 seconds!

**lazy door** You can craft a "lazy door" using 4 bog oak planks and two sticks.![Lazy door](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dee0c4c7bfc30b9b8d60cc72a1724ce1ed253aa.png)

This is my first mod. i'll happy if you tell me about my mistakes.

Mod translated on:
- English
- Russian (русский）
